name: Cassie Jennings
bio:
Hi Im, Cassie the UK Sales and safari specialist for Mazingira Safaris, and my journey with this incredible company started in 2023 when I embarked on a personal safari adventure in Tanzania. The breathtaking landscapes, the warmth of the local people, and the exceptional service provided by Mazingira Safaris instantly captured my heart. It was an experience so profound that it inspired me and my husband to forge a deeper connection with this beautiful country.
Seizing an opportunity to share this love, we began building a partnership with Mazingira Safaris to establish a sales hub in the UK. This venture allows us to bring the magic of Tanzanian safaris closer to Europe, offering tailored safari packages designed to showcase the wonders of Tanzania.
With a growing expertise in safari operations, wildlife, and local cultures, I am thrilled to share my knowledge and experiences. Alongside my wonderful team based in Tanzania, I am here to help you plan your dream safari. My goal is to enlighten others in the UK and beyond about Tanzania’s enchanting beauty and to help them discover their own unforgettable safari adventures. Join us to explore this wonderful place and create memories that will last a lifetime.
